Rodrigo Puga, Regional President - Middle East, Russia and Africa (MERA), Pfizer Photo courtesy: Pfizer

In an interview with Zawya Projects, Rodrigo Puga, Regional President for Middle East, Russia and Africa (MERA) at Pfizer, outlines the pharma giant's regional priorities—from AI-driven R&D and supply chain resilience to strategic localisation and public-private partnerships

Eman Hamed ,  ZAWYA Projects

US-based global pharmaceutical and biotechnology giant Pfizer is exploring manufacturing, technology transfer, research and capability-building partnerships across the Middle East and Africa as governments seek greater drug security and access to innovative therapies, according the company’s Regional President for Middle East, Russia and Africa (MERA).
